An actor with no provider attributes, the shape `firedrill tool add` creates; resolves to the default seeded user Ada Okonkwo.
An address with no `users` row: every call fails UNAUTHENTICATED.
Ada's address with read-only OAuth scopes: reads succeed, every write fails PERMISSION_DENIED with ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT.
Ada's address with Apps Script scopes only: every People and Workspace Events call fails PERMISSION_DENIED with ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT.
Ada's address with the contacts scope only: every Workspace Events and Apps Script call fails PERMISSION_DENIED.
Ada's address with no operation grants: the framework denies every call before behavior runs.
